nodes.label: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
nodes.author: Jiacheng Liu et al.

nodes.label: Claude Code Reverse-Engineered Architecture (agent loop, permissions, context management)
nodes.rationale: Invests engineering effort in deterministic operational infrastructure rather than explicit decision scaffolding, on the premise that a sufficiently capable model benefits more from a rich instrumented environment than from constraints on its own reasoning.

nodes.label: Evidence-Tiering Methodology (Tier A/B/C)
nodes.rationale: Separates claims from official documentation, code-verified findings, and community/inferred reconstruction so readers can see which claims rest on the strongest ground.
